------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Illinois Citizens Utility Board          edebellis@citizensutilityboard.org       smoskowitz@citizensutilityboard.org     

Basis for Intervening:
The Citizens Utility Board (CUB) was created by the Illinois General Assembly for the purpose "to promote the health, welfare and prosperity of all the citizens of this State by ensuring effective and democratic representation of utility consumers before the Illinois Commerce Commission, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the Federal Communications Commission, the courts, and other public bodies and by providing for consumer education on utility service prices and on benefits and methods of energy conservation. Such purpose shall be deemed a statewide interest and not a private or special concern." 220 ILCS 10/2. CUB represents the interests of residential and small commercial utilities ratepayers across the State of Illinois. Among these Illinois ratepayers are customers of Ameren Illinois Company, which are served by and participate in the markets operated by Midcontinent Independent System Operator.
